title: "Local Projections: From First Principles to Empirical Research"
subtitle: "Course handbook · Lectures 1–14"
author: "Tyler Sotomayor"
date: 2026-09-13
date-format: "dddd, D MMMM YYYY"

# ————— chapter opener ————— (see lectures/_pdf/handbook.tex)
kicker: "Course handbook"
course: "Local Projections: From First Principles to Empirical Research"
strand: "Collected lectures"
contents-label: "Contents of this handbook"
contents-index: true
course-handbook: true

# Each lecture is a part; sections restart at 1 inside each one, so a lecture
# numbers the same here as it does in its standalone PDF. The part dividers are
# emitted as raw LaTeX rather than as `#` headings: with a level-1 heading
# present, pandoc would demote the bodies' `##` to \subsection and number them
# 1.1 / 1.1.1. Leaving `##` as the highest markdown level keeps it \section.
number-sections: true
toc-depth: 3

fig-cap-location: top
link-citations: true

filters:
  - filters/course-apparatus.lua

format:
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    geometry:
      - letterpaper
      - top=1in
      - bottom=1in
      - left=1.15in
      - right=1in
      - headheight=14pt
    toc: false          # the contents strip is part of the opener instead
    colorlinks: true
    number-sections: true
    template-partials:
      - lectures/_pdf/title.tex
      - lectures/_pdf/before-body.tex
    include-in-header:
      - lectures/_pdf/handbook.tex
      - lectures/_pdf/handbook-parts.tex

bibliography:
  - lectures/01-question-to-projection/references.bib
  - lectures/02-transformations-and-units/references.bib
  - lectures/03-identification-and-controls/references.bib
  - lectures/04-lp-iv-and-multipliers/references.bib
  - lectures/05-pointwise-inference/references.bib
  - lectures/06-path-inference/references.bib
  - lectures/07-lp-versus-var/references.bib
  - lectures/08-smoothing-and-restrictions/references.bib
  - lectures/09-state-dependence/references.bib
  - lectures/10-nonlinear-interpretation/references.bib
  - lectures/11-panel-lps/references.bib
  - lectures/12-lp-did/references.bib
  - lectures/13-sensitivity-and-counterfactuals/references.bib
  - lectures/14-synthesis-and-audit/references.bib
csl: lectures/lp-apa.csl
---
